hero.subtitle: Ditch the cluttered spreadsheets and clunky social networks. Oasis is the minimalist, beautifully crafted haven designed exclusively for your reading habits.

problem.label: The Problem
problem.title: Goodreads is outdated. Excel is boring. Your reading life deserves better.
problem.desc: We noticed that readers were forced to choose between social networks filled with ads and toxic reviews, or boring, lifeless spreadsheets. Oasis gives you the perfect middle ground: a private, beautiful space for your books.

f1.title: Private Library
f1.desc: Your books, your business. No followers, no pressure, just your personal collection.

f2.title: Beautiful Design
f2.desc: Looks stunning on your 4K monitor, your laptop, and your smartphone. Read anywhere.

f3.title: Smart Tracking
f3.desc: Track your progress, rate your reads, and organize your backlog with zero friction.

step1.title: Create Account
step1.desc: Sign up in seconds and access your secure, private sanctuary.

step2.title: Build Library
step2.desc: Add the books you've read, are reading, or want to read next.

step3.title: Track & Review
step3.desc: Update progress and leave notes just for yourself.

cta.title: Ready to elevate your reading?
cta.desc: Join the thousands of readers who have already upgraded their digital library experience.
